title: Elide checkMissing through type assumptions and casts
motivation: `ElideCheckMissing` only looked at the inferred type of the argument itself. When the argument was a type assumption or cast of a value whose type already excluded `miss`, the `checkMissing` call stayed. In `bench_shootout_binarytrees_naive` this kept a checkpoint in promise bodies, so `StrictifyPromise` could not inline them and each call allocated them.
solution: `ElideCheckMissing` now walks the chain of `AssumeType` and `Cast` statements that the argument comes from. It removes the `checkMissing` if any value in the chain has a type without `miss`, because these statements do not change the SEXP. After that, `StrictifyPromise` inlines the promises in binarytrees.

files.server/src/main/java/org/prlprg/fir/opt/: Walks back through `AssumeType` and `Cast` statements and removes `checkMissing` when any value in the chain cannot be missing.
files.server/src/test/java/org/prlprg/fir/opt/: Adds tests for a type assumption of a promise, a narrowing assumption of a maybe-missing value, and a non-narrowing one.
